summary.text: Steve Xiarhos is a Republican member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Barnstable District since January 2021 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia, which lists him as Steven Xiarhos, gives his birthplace as New Bedford, Massachusetts, and his profession as police officer.
Xiarhos took office on January 6, 2021, and advanced from the Republican primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and the Public Safety and Homeland Security and Ways and Means joint committees, and served as ranking minority member of the Joint Committee on Emergency Preparedness and Management and the Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery Joint Committee.
